name: SOL zfav maker, early window
description: sol-zfav-maker's rule (post-only bid one tick inside the spread on the side SOL spot is >=1.5 sigma past the strike) restricted to 540..300 s before close instead of 420..150 s.
hypothesis: In sol-zfav-maker's Jun-Sep full-test fills the result improves with time to close: fills with 350-430 s left +2.5c, 280-350 s +0.85c, 200-280 s -0.1c, under 200 s -2.4c. Late fills are adversely selected (informed flow and settlement-average dynamics near the close), early ones earn the favourite premium. Restricting to 540..300 s keeps the early fills. Wrong if the full walk-forward is not above the parent's +1.18c, or months before June are negative (the diagnosis used Jun-Sep fills).
